about: the gate within the certifying source of Virginia's 2023 local contests and questions (pipeline/local_va.py, docstring), proposed by worker D3 on 2026-11-13: (a) the election's page headed 'OFFICIAL RESULTS', linked from the Department's results page, its Media Export link the file read, and the figures it shows the file's; (b) a shared contest's locality lines adding up to its statewide count; (c) all reporting; (d) the over-ballot test within each locality. Held where a part fails. Beside it: precinct lines against locality lines. Built by pipeline/local_va.py check.
